listing.name: First Persean Empire 1.1.1g
listing.summary: On the surface this militaristic, totalitarian Empire promotes an image of power and dominance, with a strong emphasis on low-tech adjacent midline ships. In reality, it is an unstable regime beset by enemies within and without, that only continues to exist due to a quirk of sector politics - a situation that is not likely to continue.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a militaristic, totalitarian faction featuring low-tech midline ships.

description: Introduces an unstable regime that projects power through dominance and specific ship designs. The faction is depicted as beset by internal and external enemies, surviving only due to political quirks.

discordPostHtml:
On the surface this militaristic, totalitarian Empire promotes an image of power and dominance, with a strong emphasis on low-tech adjacent midline ships. In reality, it is an unstable regime beset by enemies within and without, that only continues to exist due to a quirk of sector politics - a situation that is not likely to continue.

-Updated for 0.98a
-Removed Bukavac (Export), Sieger (Export)
-Reduced spawn rates of Exports
-Updated Vayra's Sector custom bounties to MagicBounty format.

-New, better flag from Maritusa! Many thanks!

-Mini-update - Fixed a flaw in the code that cut Ballistic damage dealt by FPE ships instead of boosting it.
NOT savegame compatible
